def demo_feats(a,b,name):
    si,so=shapes(a),shapes(b)
    H_in,W=len(a),len(a[0]); H_out=len(b)
    hollow=lambda s: (s['bb'][2]-s['bb'][0]+1)*(s['bb'][3]-s['bb'][1]+1)!=s['n']

    hh=[s['bb'][2]-s['bb'][0]+1 for s in hs]; sh=[s['bb'][2]-s['bb'][0]+1 for s in ss]
    f=dict(name=name,H=H_in,W=W,H_out=H_out,delta=H_out-H_in,
        nsh=len(si),nh=len(hs),ns=len(ss),ncol=len(set(s['col'] for s in si)),
        cells=sum(s['n'] for s in si),
        maxhh=max(hh),minhh=min(hh),sumhh=sum(hh),maxsh=max(sh),minsh=min(sh),sumsh=sum(sh),

        maxsb=max(s['bb'][2] for s in ss),minst=min(s['bb'][0] for s in ss),
        maxallb=max(s['bb'][2] for s in si),minallt=min(s['bb'][0] for s in si))
    return f
